health_window.answered: a delivery whose text is not the tool’s error (“Invalid response”, “An error occurred”, empty, or an error object { error } with nothing that answers)
health_window.unindexed: a delivery whose response the subgraph did not parse (toolResponse null; most of Gnosis): neither an answer nor an error. delivering_tools = on the card and delivered lately; hireable_tools = on the card and answered with text
health_window.ipfs: OLAS_IPFS_ANSWER_v1: a tool delivered but not parsed is read in what the mech delivered (<gateway>f01701220<digest>/<request id>, at most 3 files per mech and tool): it is hireable when a file names the same request and tool and its result is not the tool’s error; the evidence is answered_ipfs[tool] (chains[].ipfs counts the read)
health_window.squid: Robinhood’s squid indexes no parsed tool or response: its mechs carry health null

body.erc8004: agent_id = the chain’s IdentityRegistryBridger mapServiceIdAgentIds(service_id) (mapMultisigAgentIds(multisig) for a mech without a service); agent_uri = the bridger’s baseURI + the service id
body.how_to_hire: request(bytes requestData, uint256 maxDeliveryRate, bytes32 paymentType, address priorityMech, uint256 responseTimeout, bytes paymentData) on the row’s marketplace (chain_id); requestData = the sha256 digest of the IPFS CIDv0 of {"prompt","tool","nonce"}; native payment sends value = maxDeliveryRate. Pick a tool from hireable_tools; its input/output schema is card.tool_metadata[tool].
